translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

content: Gor Kawnan Tep Ak Akaŋ, Tap Key Bap Kuyip Gos Ñimb

Buŋgiy tep yand gok. Biynimb Gor minim yesek aŋgrapay gok kuŋay mindpay ak mey, biynimb gunap Gor Kawnan yip mindpun aŋgeniŋgiy niŋrep giy minim kuyip ak dinimimb. Gor Kawnan apay ak pen: Gor Kawnan yipund giy akaŋ, tap gunap key kuyip gos ñek aspay akaŋ aŋgiy niŋnimimb.
Pen Gor Kawnan ak yip mindiy aŋgniŋgambay, “Bi Jiysis Krays ak, Gor Ñinuk. Nuk biyimb ay owak aŋgniŋgambay.”

Pen Gor Ñinuk biyimb rek ay ma awak aŋgniŋgambay ak; Gor Kawnan ak yip ma mindeniŋgambay. Tap Krays nup miluk niŋimb bap yip mindiy mey, minim kun ak rek aŋgniŋgambay. Biynimb kun ak rek mindeniŋgambay aŋgey niŋbik. Pen miñiy gunap mindpay ak; niŋrep ginimimb.
Ñapan yand gok. Nimb Gor biynimb nuk mindpim rek, minim yesek kiyk apay ak, taw achip achip gipim. Kawnan niŋind yimb nimbip gos ñimb ak, kilis timey yimb; kuyip gos ñimb ak, kilis ma mindip.
Kiyk biynimb yikop tap lum biy nimb gok gosimb niŋbay ak mey; tap yikop lum ar biy nimb minim ak aŋgey niŋbay.

Pen chin Gor Ñapan nuk mindpun rek, biynimb Gor nup dipay gok, minim chinup ak dipay. Biynimb nup ma dipay gok, minim chinup ak ma dipay. Ar kun ak Gor Kawnan yip mindiy apay akaŋ, tap bap key gos ñek apay ak niŋbun.
Gor Chinup Wasemb Yimb Ayip
Biynimb tep yand gok. Gor biynimb nuk mindpun ak, penpen wasemb ayjun. Biynimb wasemb aypay gok, Gor nup chiŋgiy, ñapan nuk mindiy mey, wasemb aypay.
Pen biynimb wasemb ma aypay gok, Gor bi biynimb wasemb ayip ak nup ma dipay.
Chinup wasemb yimb ayip rek niŋyaŋ aŋgiy, Ñinuk nokom yimb ak yokek apiy gek, perper mindonjun rek ayip.
Wasemb yimb ayep ar ak, chinup kind ak ma tikjakak; Gor kind nuk ak tikjakak. Chinup wasemb ay Ñinuk nup yokek apiy, tap siy tap timey gipun rek simboŋgak.
Buŋgiy tep yand gok. Nuk chinup kun giy wasemb yimb ayip ak; chin ñapan nuk gok, penpen wasemb ayjun.
Gor nup miseŋ ma niŋbun ak pen; penpen wasemb aypun ak keynep ma gipun, nuk chin yip mindakniŋ gipun. Nuk chin yip mindip ak mey, nuk biynimb wasemb yimb ayip rek gipun.
Chinup Kawnan nuk yokek yip mindiy mey, nuk yip nep mindpun ak niŋrep gipun.
Nop Ñinuk bi biynimb di jimñemb ak yokek apek, windin chin key niŋnuk ak mey; biynimb miñmon okok keykey kuyip gos niŋiy yokak ak, niŋrep giy biynimb aŋgñimbun.
Biynimb Jiysis Gor Ñinuk yimb aŋgiy miseŋ apay gok, Gor kiy yip mindakniŋ, nup chiŋgiy, kun ak rek niŋiy apay.
Chin key Gor wasemb ayip ak niŋrep giy, ar kun ak gon amimb. Gor bi wasemb ayep. Biynimb wasemb aypay gok, nup chiŋgey kiy yip mindakniŋ, wasemb aypay.
Chin Gor nup gosimb niŋbun gok, Krays mindip rek mindiy, biynimb gunap kuyip direp yimb gipun. Kun ak kor yomb giniŋgamb ak niŋon, jel ma gip.

Biynimb penpen wasemb yimb aypay gok, penpen niŋey, jel ma giniŋgamb. Kun ak rek, chin biynimb Gor yip penpen wasemb yimb aypun gok, kunep jel gek ma pirikpun. Biynimb pirikpay gok, Gor nup wasemb yimb ma aypay.
Gor nuk key chinup wasemb ayek mey, nup pen wasemb aypun.

Biynimb Gor nup wasemb aypun aŋgniŋgambay ak pen; mam ay gok kuyip miluk niŋniŋgambay ak, yesek nep aŋgniŋgambay. Biynimb miseŋ niŋbay gok kuyip, miluk niŋniŋgambay ak, yergiy Gor bi miseŋ ma niŋbay ak nup, wasemb ayniŋgambay.
Gor aŋgak, “Biynimb yip wasemb ayniŋgiy gok, mam ay gok kuyip kunep wasemb ayniŋgiy aŋgak.”
